headline: The year of two Thanksgivings
post_facts: FDR moved Thanksgiving up one week

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen thirty-nine... America celebrated Thanksgiving a week early. Well... some of America.

scenes.label: Franklin D. Roosevelt
scenes.caption: Associated Press photo, 1939
scenes.title: A longer Christmas shopping season
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] President Franklin Roosevelt moved the holiday up one week, to give stores a longer Christmas shopping season.

scenes.label: Thanksgivings in one year
scenes.text: [calmly] Many states refused, so America had two Thanksgivings... and Texas celebrated both.

scenes.title: Fixed by law in 1941
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] In nineteen forty-one, Congress settled it for good... the fourth Thursday of November.
